name: deerflow-vscode-copilot-bridge
description: Loopback bridge from DeerFlow to VS Code Copilot Language Model API.

commands.title: DeerFlow Copilot Bridge: Open DeerFlow UI
DeerFlow Copilot Bridge: Configure DeerFlow Account

deerflowCopilotBridge.host.description: Host interface for the local bridge. Keep this on loopback unless you fully trust the network.

deerflowCopilotBridge.model.description: Preferred Copilot model id for warmup and copilot-auto requests.

deerflowCopilotBridge.family.description: Optional preferred Copilot model family, such as gpt-4o. Empty selects the first available Copilot model.

deerflowCopilotBridge.reasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort forwarded to Copilot requests when the caller does not specify one.

deerflowCopilotBridge.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for real Copilot requests and warmup checks. When this expires, the bridge reports that model access is still pending.

deerflowCopilotBridge.token.description: Optional bearer token required by the bridge. Leave empty only when bound to loopback.

deerflowCopilotBridge.autoStart.description: Start the loopback bridge when VS Code starts. Model consent is still requested from user-initiated commands.

deerflowCopilotBridge.launchTimeoutMs.description: How long the one-click workbench launcher waits for DeerFlow local services before opening the UI anyway.
